blocks.text: Five years after the release of their last album, acclaimed synth-pop trio CHVRCHES – Lauren Mayberry, Martin Doherty and Iain Cook – have announced their return with a new single, the bold, caustic rock anthem “Roses”. Premiering as BBC Radio 1’s Hottest Record, the song serves as a mission statement for the band’s sonic shift, letting us in on the opening chapter of an entirely new era. “Roses” is out today via Futures Music Group (Lykke Li, Phantogram, Mt. Joy, et. al). LISTEN TO “ROSES” HERE “Roses” is a scathing piece of contemporary social commentary, a confrontation with the darker undercurrents […]...
